allocation_complete.reason: The BMS-relevant obligation (a reported state of charge) is covered by SOC_ACCURACY, its reliability by SOC_INVALID_FLAG; percent display/resolution is VCU-side.

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_SOC_ACCURACY and BMS_REQ_SOC_INVALID_FLAG are imported BMS interface needs (tag interface), bev-only like the element.

no_value_copy.reason: Names no BMS value; accuracy and timeout stay in the allocated needs.

parent_fit.reason: Provides the state of charge the vehicle must display per REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE (bev variant), including its validity.

variant_consistency.reason: Variant folder subsystems/bms (bev only), same as the bev variant of its parent.
